followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: The wartime outward-travel restriction and later age exemption are supported as national cohort policies. They do not establish closure of all Ukrainian frontier traffic. P1 concerns the general male-citizen 18–60 rule with exemptions. P2 concerns the remaining non-exempt 23–60 cohort after most 18–22-year-olds became eligible with documents; specified office-holder limits remain. The initial official notice is 24 February 2022. The amendment is effective on 28 August 2025, matching the implementation notice. The 11 September 2025 assessment supplies the later policy observation. Changing exemptions prevent a stable complete operational duration; neither phase receives one. The official initial notice connects the exit restriction to martial law. Security / Armed conflict remains source-attributed; mobilisation eligibility is a separate rule and is not substituted for exit permission. Official notices were read directly, the legislative text through an indexed extract after 403, and the dated Home Office assessment directly. The district notice’s 1030/registry 1031 discrepancy is already preserved. The Home Office wrapper’s 22 October 2026 update is not a new observation date. Both phases remain unlocated. A national outward cohort policy does not establish the operating status of every Ukraine–neighbour crossing or either side of a war-front boundary.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge

Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
